_comment: Your toolbar. Copy to ~/.config/oszt/buttons.json and edit freely -
adding a button never needs a code change, and restarting the toolbar picks
kind: agent      = turn Hermes on and off
kind: live_feed  = turn screen watching on and off
kind: goal       = send one fixed instruction to Hermes
kind: capability = call one broker capability directly
A capability button still obeys the policy: if the policy does not allow it,
the button reports the refusal and nothing happens.

buttons.label: CLN
buttons.goal: Find what is using the most disk space and clean the caches you are allowed to clean.
